products.name: You.com Enterprise
products.note: Private search AI; no tracking; enterprise deployment; data privacy focus

profile_text.body:
You.com is a for-profit startup founded in 2020 and headquartered in Palo Alto, CA. The company describes itself as a provider of web search APIs designed for AI applications, positioning its offerings around accuracy, freshness, and latency for AI agents.

The company tracks two products: You.com, a search-augmented large language model chat interface, and You.com Enterprise, a private search AI product aimed at enterprise deployment with a focus on data privacy and no user tracking.

No litigation, MCP registry presence, or SEC filings are recorded in the held facts for this company.
